messages.subject: Re: verbose<-Arguments$getVerbose(-8)
parts:
On 26 juin, 13:03, Ray <Raymond.Robe...@ncf.edu> wrote:
> What does the -8 do in this function?
> verbose<-Arguments$getVerbose(-8)

Quoting Henrik in the thread "decrease verbosity":
The smaller number (-20 is smaller than -10), the more details. So,
verbose=0 (or FALSE) gives no details, verbose=-1 (TRUE) somewhat
more, verbose=-2 even more and so on. Think of the value as the
"threshold" that one has to overcome in order for output to be
displayed.

Best,
Nicolas
